detailed_descriptions.en: BECOME A CAT WIZARD Play as magical cats — cute, clumsy, unpredictable, and expressive. Customize your cat to your liking. VOICE-POWERED MAGIC Cast spells with your mic. Learn new spells and practice them with your cat friends. Shoot fireballs at enemies, levitate any object, or summon a massive tornado. CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPELLS Assign unique names to every spell in your magical arsenal. Words, syllables, wild combos — surprise your friends and build a set that's all your own! CHAOTIC CO-OP Magic affects everyone. Set your friend’s tail on fire, lift each other with levitation to cross obstacles, meow to revive teammates, and discover hilarious spell interactions together. LOOT & EXTRACTION Collect valuable loot during expeditions and fight your way back to the hot-air balloon, defending your haul from monsters. FAIRY-TALE FLAIR Explore stylized floating islands, fantasy dungeons, and vibrant locations wrapped in a light fairy-tale atmosphere.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
BECOME A CAT WIZARD

Play as magical cats — cute, clumsy, unpredictable, and expressive. Customize your cat to your liking.

VOICE-POWERED MAGIC

Cast spells with your mic. Learn new spells and practice them with your cat friends. Shoot fireballs at enemies, levitate any object, or summon a massive tornado.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPELLS

Assign unique names to every spell in your magical arsenal. Words, syllables, wild combos — surprise your friends and build a set that's all your own!

CHAOTIC CO-OP

Magic affects everyone. Set your friend’s tail on fire, lift each other with levitation to cross obstacles, meow to revive teammates, and discover hilarious spell interactions together.

LOOT & EXTRACTION

Collect valuable loot during expeditions and fight your way back to the hot-air balloon, defending your haul from monsters.

FAIRY-TALE FLAIR

Explore stylized floating islands, fantasy dungeons, and vibrant locations wrapped in a light fairy-tale atmosphere.
